subject: config: enable Broadcom, Redpine and Atheros AR9271 USB Wi-Fi (#110)
author: Michael Ferguson

upstream.vanilla_file_line: drivers/net/wireless/rsi/Kconfig:47-51 (linux-6.18.57) -- RSI_COEX, `default y`; BT_HCIRSI is a bare tristate selected through it
upstream.vanilla_quote:
config RSI_COEX
	bool "Redpine Signals WLAN BT Coexistence support"
	depends on BT && RSI_91X
	depends on !(BT=m && RSI_91X=y)
	default y

provenance_doc_ref: none -- postdates docs/patch-provenance.md. Our side is PR #216 (Wi-Fi/BT parity vs stock 20260912).

impact.effect_if_absent: On stock: brcmfmac USB, Redpine RS9113/RS9116 USB (Wi-Fi + BT) and ath9k_htc (AR9271/AR7010) dongles have no driver. On our image: none -- every symbol already resolves the same.

forward_port.effort: none -- kconfig only, already in our linux.config

superseded_by: board/mister/de10nano/linux.config:356-358 CONFIG_WLAN_VENDOR_RSI=y, CONFIG_RSI_91X=m, CONFIG_RSI_USB=m (RSI_COEX, RSI_DEBUGFS, BT_HCIRSI follow)

notes:
OUTBOUND, like the 2026-09-14 increment: authored in this repo and sent upstream as fork PR #110 (head mcfbytes:config-brcmfmac-rsi, merged 2026-10-02). scripts/check-fork-sync.sh cannot tell direction, so the record is the evidence that the upstreaming landed and that our image already has it.

MEASURED on the resolved output/build/linux-6.18.57/.config (DE10, full series): all 18 symbols the fork commit sets or unsets (BT_HCIRSI, ATH9K_HW, ATH9K_COMMON, ATH9K_BTCOEX_SUPPORT, ATH9K off, ATH9K_HTC, WLAN_VENDOR_BROADCOM, BRCMUTIL, BRCMFMAC, BRCMFMAC_PROTO_BCDC, BRCMFMAC_SDIO off, BRCMFMAC_USB, WLAN_VENDOR_RSI, RSI_91X, RSI_DEBUGFS, RSI_SDIO off, RSI_USB, RSI_COEX) resolve to the fork's values. DE25 (output-de25/build/linux-7.3/.config) has the four user-facing ones (ATH9K_HTC, BRCMFMAC_USB, RSI_USB, BT_HCIRSI) too.
